title: Solar Power Design and Installation Basics

questions.q: In "How a rooftop system works and what a site needs Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: Target size: yearly use divided by (peak sun hours x 365 x 0.8). Pick the smaller of roof limit and target.
Draw a single-line sketch: panels, strings, isolator, inverter, protection, meter. Label each part by function, not by brand.

questions.q: In "Kick-off circle Understand", which of these is a key idea?
